fusions.name: Hardseed Spit
fusions.desc: Spits a hard seed that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 40% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Pulled Root
fusions.desc: Draws out every affliction you have on the target, dealing 50% more damage for each one drawn. The strike itself deals 15 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Greener Pasture
fusions.desc: Raises a patch of grazing where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Sun on the Slope
fusions.desc: In daylight, your armour rises by 12%. You regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
